subtopic: Friend succeeds when you are struggling
passage:
I'm Yamini, and when Vaibhav told me he'd got the internship at the software firm, I said "Wow, that's amazing!" and hugged him in the corridor, my face smiling on its own. Inside I felt small. I had applied to the same firm and heard nothing.

That night I texted him "So proud of you 🎉" and meant it, mostly. Then I lay awake admitting to myself, only to myself, that I was jealous. What surprised me was that the envy pointed at something: I didn't actually want that firm, I wanted work where I build things, and I'd been applying by default.

Two days later I told Vaibhav I'd been a little jealous and was still glad for him. He laughed and said he'd been jealous of my grades for a year.

qa.q: What did Yamini text Vaibhav that night?
qa.a: "So proud of you", with a party emoji.

qa.q: What was Yamini feeling behind the smile in the corridor, and how can you tell?
qa.a: Small and jealous. The smile felt automatic, and Yamini later lay awake admitting the envy privately.

qa.q: How did Yamini use the envy well?
qa.a: Yamini admitted it privately, congratulated Vaibhav honestly and used the feeling to see what work Yamini actually wanted.

qa.q: How did Vaibhav react to the confession, and what does that show?
qa.a: He laughed and said he had been jealous of Yamini's grades for a year, so the honesty made the friendship feel more equal. 🙂

grounding: A friend gets the offer while Yamini has heard nothing; Yamini smiles while feeling small, admits the envy privately, congratulates honestly and clarifies what Yamini wants.
